name: A description the record plainly does not meet
target_description: This role is for a senior structural engineer working on bridge and viaduct projects. You will produce stamped calculations for concrete and steel structures, lead site inspections of load-bearing elements, and sign off on designs under a professional engineering licence. A degree in civil or structural engineering and a current PE licence are required, along with ten years of design experience on transport infrastructure and working knowledge of the relevant national design codes.
